documents.title: Diabatix ColdStream
documents.content: ColdStream by Diabatix is an AI-driven thermal design platform that automatically generates and optimizes heat sinks and cold plates for maximum cooling performance. It leverages advanced simulation and artificial intelligence to explore thousands of design variations and deliver high-performance thermal solutions in a fraction of traditional design time.

documents.title: AI Heat Sink Optimization
documents.content: ColdStream automatically designs high-performance air-cooled heat sinks by optimizing fin geometry, spacing, and overall topology for minimal thermal resistance and pressure drop. The AI engine evaluates thousands of configurations to achieve superior cooling performance while meeting manufacturing and spatial constraints.

documents.title: Liquid Cold Plate Design
documents.content: ColdStream enables intelligent liquid cold plate design by optimizing internal channel layouts, flow distribution, and thermal performance. The AI-driven workflow balances heat transfer and pressure drop to deliver compact, high-efficiency cooling solutions suitable for high-power electronics and battery systems.

documents.title: AI-Driven Thermal Design Workflow
documents.content: ColdStream replaces manual iteration with automated AI-based optimization. Engineers define design constraints such as thermal load, allowable pressure drop, material, and envelope dimensions. The platform then autonomously generates, evaluates, and refines geometries using high-fidelity simulations, significantly reducing development time and engineering effort.

documents.title: Electronics & High-Power Applications
documents.content: ColdStream is used for high-performance cooling applications including data centers, power electronics, automotive inverters, battery systems, and semiconductor devices. It supports both air and liquid cooling strategies and is particularly suited for high heat flux and space-constrained applications.

documents.title: What are the benefits of ColdStream?
documents.content: ColdStream significantly reduces design time by automating thermal optimization. It improves cooling performance, reduces material usage, and lowers development costs by minimizing physical prototyping. The AI-based workflow enables engineers to focus on system integration while the platform handles geometry optimization.
